DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis).

The patient is a pregnant woman at 30 weeks gestation presenting with fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise after consuming unpasteurized dairy products (ice cream) three days ago. This clinical picture is highly suggestive of listeriosis, a serious infection that can cause severe flu-like symptoms and meningitis in pregnant women.
